newsitem.title: GERMANY: German sugar beet campaign ahead of last year.
newsitem.headline: German sugar beet campaign ahead of last year.

text.p: German sugar beet deliveries to refineries on Nov 1 were 12.90 million tonnes, up from 12.71 milllion a year earlier, sugar industry association WVZ said in its sixth report of the 1996/97 campaign.
Sugar content at delivery on Nov 1 was 18.02 percent, up from 16.69 percent a year earlier.
WVZ maintained its forecast for final beet deliveries of 26.43 million tonnes, up from a final 26.05 million in 1995/96.
WVZ will run delivery updates until the end of the campaign in January on a weekly basis.
Deliveries to refineries up to Oct 25 were 10.76 million, up from 10.49 million last year and sugar content at that stage was 17.95 percent, up from 16.66 percent previously.
